findings.evidence: `basis_mul_basis` (OrthogonalBasis.lean:235) needs only `hb`: reversing the factors preserves `∏ i ∈ s ∩ t, Q (b i)` and changes only the power of −1. `monomialGroup` (MonomialGroup.lean:87) is generated by −1 and generator units; their commutation up to central sign persists under products and inverses regardless of their squares.
findings.fix: Prove the basis relation with only `hb`, comparing the coefficients in `basis_mul_basis`; prove the group relation by closure induction on its generators, then derive the conjugacy result without `hQ`.
findings.issue: Remove the overly strong `hQ` assumption from `basis_mul_basis_comm_or_neg` and from `MonomialGroup.lean`'s `monomialGroup_mul_comm_or_neg` (line 446) and `monomialGroup_val_eq_or_neg_of_isConj` (line 485). These relations also hold for arbitrary orthogonal generator squares.

summary: The commute-or-anticommute relations and their conjugacy consequence unnecessarily require generator squares to be ±1.
